blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Artificial intelligence — AI — is software that can do tasks that usually need human thinking. It can recognise a face in a photo, translate a sentence, answer a question, or suggest a next action. It learns from large amounts of data and finds patterns that a human would take much longer to see.

AI is not magic. It is mathematics, running on a lot of hardware, trained on a lot of examples. It does some things very well and other things very badly. One of the first skills is learning to tell the difference.

AI changes how companies work. It does not replace human judgement, but it can make human judgement much faster and much better informed.

items.q: What is AI, according to the text?
options: A robot with a human face
Software that can do tasks that usually need human thinking
items.why: "AI is software that can do tasks that usually need human thinking."

items.q: How does AI learn?
options: From a teacher in a classroom
items.why: "It learns from large amounts of data and finds patterns."

items.q: The text says AI is "not magic". This suggests that…
options: AI is based on mathematics and examples, not on tricks
items.why: Inferência: "não é mágica" quer dizer que AI é matemática e exemplos — tem uma explicação real.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: AI does some things well and some things badly
AI will fully replace human judgement
AI can make human decisions faster
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "It does not replace human judgement" — o autor discorda dessa ideia.

items.q: Why is it important to "tell the difference"?
options: Because AI does some things well and others very badly
items.why: Inferência: como AI acerta em algumas tarefas e erra em outras, é preciso saber quando confiar nela.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicando ao novo colega o que é a IA. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team. Before the big meeting tomorrow, let me tell you what AI really is. It is not a robot. It is not science fiction. It is just software that learns from data.

Here is a simple example. Our support team gets thousands of emails every week. A chatbot can read them and answer the easy questions in seconds. That is AI. It finds patterns and it acts fast.

But I want you to remember one thing. AI is not always right. It is very good with numbers and patterns. It is not good with judgement. So we still need people. AI gives us speed, and people give us good decisions.

Tomorrow the leaders will ask, "Will AI take our jobs?" My answer is no. AI helps us work faster. It does the boring tasks, and we do the important thinking. If you understand that, you already understand the basics.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does James say AI is?
items.why: "It is just software that learns from data."

items.q: What example does James give?
options: A chatbot that answers support emails
items.why: "A chatbot can read them and answer the easy questions in seconds."

items.q: According to James, what is AI NOT good at?
items.why: "It is not good with judgement. So we still need people."

items.q: James says "we still need people". This suggests that…
options: AI and people work best together
items.why: Inferência: AI dá velocidade e as pessoas dão boas decisões — os dois se completam.

items.q: How would you describe James's message about jobs?
items.why: Inferência: ele responde "no" à pergunta sobre perder empregos e explica com calma que a AI ajuda.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The app can translate the email into Portuguese." To translate means to…
options: change words from one language to another
items.why: Translate = traduzir: passar de uma língua para outra.

items.q: "AI can find a pattern in the sales data." A pattern is…
options: a thing that repeats or a regular shape
items.why: Pattern = padrão: algo que se repete nos dados.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The software can ___ your face and open the door."
items.why: Recognise = reconhecer: identificar o rosto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A computer needs a lot of ___ to solve the problem."
items.why: Mathematics = matemática: a base de como a AI funciona.

items.q: "The model is trained on many examples." Trained means…
items.why: Trained = treinado: a AI aprende com muitos exemplos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de negócios. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The company will roll out the new AI tool next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar, começar a usar em toda a empresa.

items.q: "The manager needs to sign off on the plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar oficialmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Some workers pushed back on the new AI system." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar de algo.

items.q: "Please keep up with the news about AI." To keep up with means to…
items.why: Keep up with = acompanhar, ficar por dentro.

items.q: "The new tool can speed up our work." To speed up means to…
items.why: Speed up = acelerar, tornar mais rápido.
